channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
item.description: GitHub may temporarily require authentication for some HTTPS clones and fetches of public repositories during unusual traffic to protect github.com's availability, with affected operations failing with an authentication-required message rather than reflecting a general public-repo policy. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
item.description: Norforge found one hacker used open-source AI platform Cairn to orchestrate largely autonomous agents that breached over 100 sites, including John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins, with an intrusion plan under 100 Chinese characters and a breach in about 23 hours.

item.title: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
item.description: Apple’s macOS 27 and Xcode 27 remove Intel x86_64 code from system libraries CodeQL relies on, blocking traced scans and Swift 6.4 analysis, so pin workflows to macOS 26/Xcode 26 or use build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Disney found a way to buy Character.AI without buying its lawsuits
item.description: Disney is using Character.AI’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy to hire most of its staff for $5.5 million plus a $2 million refundable deposit and a perpetual technology license, leaving litigation and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories behind.

item.title: The Thin Orchestrator: How We Made Our AI Agents More Reliable by Giving the Router Less to Do
item.description: Meta’s roughly 1,300-line thin orchestrator routes 20+ data-pipeline workflows to 14 context-isolated specialized subagents and does no domain reasoning itself, fixing production hallucinations seen when one all-in-one agent handled 3 codebases, 3 languages and up to 6 onboarding stages.

item.title: Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter!
item.description: Inception's diffusion model Mercury 3 is live on OpenRouter with over 1,000 tok/s generation, a 1M context window, 4x the speed of Mercury 2.5, and launch pricing of $0.10/M input and $0.35/M output.

item.title: OpenAI rolls out major ChatGPT extension upgrade with cross-tab context reading and automated actions
item.description: OpenAI rolls out major ChatGPT extension upgrade with cross-tab context reading and automated actions (AIbase)

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scores 45 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, improving on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash by 6 points, and is th...
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 scores 45 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, 6 points above DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, tying GLM-5.3 for second among open-weight models behind MiMo-V2.6-Pro.

item.title: Exciting news: Muse Wonder Full (Max) by @AIatMeta has just debuted in the Code Arena: WebDev at #6 overall with 1726 pts, putting Meta i...
item.description: Meta's Muse Wonder Full (Max) debuts at #6 on Code Arena: WebDev with 1726 points, making Meta the third lab in the top three and landing 75 points and 11 places above Muse Wonder (Max).

item.title: inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts
item.description: Ant's inclusionAI released Ming-3.0-tts on GitHub under MIT, pairing a 0.5B dense model with a Ling V3-based tiny (7.9B total, 1.3B active) for multilingual, paralinguistic-controlled speech synthesis, with weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

item.title: Run your n8n AI workflows on NVIDIA DGX Spark, with no cloud API
item.description: n8n's tutorial shows deploying seven local models on one NVIDIA DGX Spark with 128GB unified memory, routed through a single LiteLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint to drive n8n workflows with no cloud API calls, aimed at clinics or law firms handling sensitive client data. (n8n Blog)

item.title: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
item.description: Numan’s AI health coach Nu, built on LangGraph and LangSmith, replaced single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues with category-scored topic datasets, simulated patient conversations using cheaper models, and safety regressions that automatically block releases.

item.title: Introducing TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium
item.description: AWS released TorchNeuron, an open-source native PyTorch backend for Trainium chips that supports eager execution and torch.compile, as an Apache 2.0 public beta from October 20 on GitHub.

item.title: From Carmaker to Global Smart-Tech Company: Chery's Global Innovation Conference Makes a Major Splash with the Debut of the Industry's First Sector-Specific Large Model and Humanoid Robot "Mobo
item.description: Chery used its Global Innovation Conference to announce a shift from automaker to global smart technology company and unveil two launches: the industry's first vertical-domain large model and a humanoid robot named "Mobao. (AIbase)

item.title: Inside Prometheus: Meta’s Journey to a Gigawatt-Scale Supercluster
item.description: Meta’s gigawatt-scale Prometheus supercluster in New Albany, Ohio, has its first phase built and training Muse foundation models, with hundreds of thousands of GPUs already deployed and a full-scale target of roughly 1 million GPUs at over 85% pretraining goodput.

item.title: ByteDance's Volcano Engine pours cash into incubating AI dramas, with up to 200,000 yuan per title for the monthly Top 10
item.description: ByteDance's Volcano Engine is paying up to 200,000 yuan per work to the top 10 AI-generated short dramas selected each month, spelling out the platform's concrete subsidy levels for AI drama content. (AIbase)

item.title: headroomlabs-ai/headroom — Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
item.description: Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks locally before they reach the LLM, cutting coding-agent tokens by 20% and JSON tokens by 60-95% with unchanged answers at 0.21 ms p50 for 10K-token JSON. (GitHub Trending)
